purpose: Present a small related set of truthful metrics with consistent value, trend, progress, chart, action, and footer anatomy.
accessibility: Expose a stable group label and preserve dt and dd semantics inside every KPI item.
Give charts and icon-only actions explicit accessible names; never encode status in colour alone.
responsive: Horizontal groups collapse to two columns and visual-heavy KPI groups collapse to one column on narrow screens.
Vertical orientation retains separators and reading order without duplicating the component family.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: items
api.description: Structured items rendered by the contract.

api.name: items[].emphasis
api.description: Applies the bounded surface treatment to one KPI item.

api.name: items[].tone
api.type: neutral | primary | accent | success | warning | danger | info
api.description: Selects the semantic status or non-status accent for an explicitly emphasized item.

api.name: items[].colorway
api.description: Selects a categorical series for soft, expressive or solid emphasis. Solid uses a centrally paired foreground; tone retains semantic meaning.

api.name: items[].trend
api.description: Directional comparison slot for one KPI item.

api.name: items[].chart
api.description: Compact historical cue for one KPI item.

api.name: items[].chartPlacement
api.description: Places one chart at the item base or beside its value and supporting context.

api.name: items[].progress
api.description: Goal or capacity cue for one KPI item.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: variant
api.description: Keeps related metrics joined or presents them as individually bounded KPI cards.

api.name: orientation
api.description: Chooses a horizontal responsive group or an explicit vertical stack.

api.name: columns
api.defaultValue: derived from item count, capped at 4
api.description: Sets the maximum wide-layout column count while package breakpoints retain responsive ownership.
